items.title: Christine Jensen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 4, 2024
items.q: I totally agree with her. I mean I’m told to have this app on my phone that’s called “Spotify Artist” where I count, and the industry is counting how many people are listening to my music.

ctx.x: It’s like what’s new THIS week.

Actually what I really don’t like, again I guess I’m getting old because I’ve lived through a generation of the heyday of making money off records in jazz. Or not even making money but like clearing a profit. Maybe a small profit, but not going the other way. And now with the gobbling up of our, you know the Maria Schneider whole thing that she’s gone into with the digital world gobbling us up, I totally agree with her. I mean I’m told to have this app on my phone that’s called “Spotify Artist” where I count, and…
industry is counting how many people are listening to my music. And they can really see it.
